title: Session lock, logout, and clock
intro: Use the sidebar bottom controls to lock the terminal, log out, open your clock/session screen, or open Settings. Idle lock/logout can also run from session security settings.

sections.title: Sidebar session controls
steps: User icon opens Clock (session and sale summary).
Lock keeps your user but returns to the login screen.
Power logout ends the session and returns to open login.
sections.caption: Settings, clock, lock, and logout on the sidebar.

sections.title: Lock terminal
sections.intro: Lock is for short breaks so only the same user can unlock.
steps: The login screen returns with a locked banner naming who locked it.
Enter the same user’s PIN or password to unlock.
sections.caption: System locked banner on login.

sections.title: Clock screen
sections.intro: Clock shows your active time entry, shift, elapsed time, and sale metrics for this session.
steps: Open Clock from the user icon on the sidebar.
You need an open clock-in (some venues require clock-in after login).
Review sale summary widgets and clock-in time before clock-out.
sections.caption: Clock screen overview.

sections.title: User, shift, and clock-out
steps: Confirm signed-in user and optional shift hours.
Watch live elapsed time since clock-in.
Tap Clock Out only when your shift work is finished — this signs you out of the POS.
sections.caption: Session panel with Clock Out.

sections.title: Session sale summary
steps: Metrics cover sales, refunds, service charges, discounts, taxes, extras, voids, and tips for the current clock-in session.
Use this before clock-out for a quick performance check.
sections.caption: Sale summary metrics.

sections.title: Idle lock or logout (settings)
sections.intro: On Settings, Session security can automatically lock or log out after idle minutes.
steps: Enable the idle timer, set minutes, and choose Lock or Logout.
Save. When idle limit is hit, the POS locks or logs out and shows a toast.
sections.caption: Session security card.
